义项: 动词 使石化（petrified wood / forest）
动词 (引申义) 使吓呆；使僵住（be petrified with fear）
搭配说明: petrified — adj. 石化的；吓呆的——真题以此形出现
petrification — n. 石化（作用）
petrify ≠ putrefy — 形近异义：后者是「腐烂」

例句.英文: Behind the lamassu, more columns sprouted from the ground like ancient trees in a petrified forest, forty feet tall, spindly but still miraculously upright.
例句.原书高亮: like ancient trees in a petrified forest
例句.中文: 可它依然令人惊叹。在那尊人首牛身像之后，更多柱子从地面拔起，像一片石化森林里的古树，高达四十英尺，细长却仍奇迹般地直立着。

义项: 形容词 多孔的；疏松的（a porous molecular structure）
形容词 (引申义) （边界、制度）疏松易渗透的
搭配说明: porosity — n. 孔隙度
porous ≠ porous structure — 真题取材料科学义：靠吸附储气
permeable — adj. 可渗透的——真题亦现，近义

例句.英文: Hayden A. Evans et al.therefore explored aluminum formate (ALF), an inexpensive material with a porous molecular structure that enables gas storage by adsorption, as an alternative storage medium.
例句.中文: 因此 Hayden A. Evans 等人研究了甲酸铝（ALF）——一种价格低廉、具有多孔分子结构、可借吸附储存气体的材料——把它作为另一种储氢介质。

义项: 名词 务实；实用性（the practicality that led to his success）
[辨析] practicality（务实、可行）≠ practicability（可实施性）
搭配说明: practical / practically — adj. 务实的 / adv. 几乎；实际上
impracticable — adj. 行不通的——真题另现
pragmatism — n. 实用主义——近义

例句.英文: Reagan as a politician is often thought of as being a strict ideological conservative, but this belief obscures the practicality that led to his success—he was willing to compromise and cooperate with people he disagreed with in order to advance his objectives.
例句.原书高亮: obscures the practicality that led to his success
例句.中文: 作为政治人物，里根常被视为严格的意识形态保守派；但这种看法遮蔽了成就他的那种务实——他愿意与自己意见相左的人妥协、合作，以推进自己的目标。

义项: 动词 先于；在…之前（the 28 days preceding each point）
[辨析] precede（时间 / 顺序上在前）≠ proceed（继续进行）≠ exceed（超过）
搭配说明: preceding / precedent — adj. 在前的 / n. 先例
precedence — n. 优先（权）：take precedence over
precede ≠ predate — 后者是「（年代上）早于」，真题亦现

例句.英文: They then calculated the productivity loss of those groups at 12 weeks and 12 months after the programs began (based on the 28 days preceding each point).
例句.中文: 随后他们分别计算了这些小组在项目启动后12周与12个月时的生产力损失（以每个时间点之前28天为依据）。

例句.英文: Modern Pueblo tribal nations were preceded by the Ancestral Puebloan civilization, which occupied parts of the southwestern US until approximately 1600 CE. .
例句.中文: 现代普韦布洛部落民族的前身是祖先普韦布洛文明，后者在美国西南部一直存续到约公元 1600 年。

义项: 副词 优先地；有偏向地（preferentially defend against）
[构词] prefer + -ential + -ly
搭配说明: preferential / preference — adj. 优先的 / n. 偏好
preferentially ≠ preferably — 后者是「最好、更可取地」
preferentially ≠ preferentially to — 真题作 preferentially defend against 优先防御

例句.英文: The researchers concluded that whiteflies induce tomato plants to emit chemicals that cause other tomato plants to preferentially defend against microbial infection even when under herbivorous attack.
例句.原书高亮: to preferentially defend against microbial infection
例句.中文: 研究者得出结论：粉虱会诱导番茄植株释放化学物质，使其他番茄植株即便在遭受植食性侵害时，也优先防御微生物感染。

义项: 形容词 巨大的；惊人的；非凡的（prodigious imagination / output / memory）
[辨析] prodigious（量大到惊人，多褒义）≠ prodigal（挥霍的；浪子回头的）
搭配说明: prodigy — n. 天才（儿童）；奇才——同根
prodigiously — adv. 惊人地
prodigious ≠ prestigious — 形近异义：后者是「有声望的」

例句.英文: That his work is enjoyable despite this is a testament to his prodigious imagination-even if people read his books only for the ideas, they will have plenty to consider. Text 2Asimov is critiqued for his style, but it is wrong to fault a writer for failing to do what he never intended to do.
例句.中文: 尽管如此，他的作品仍然好看，这正证明了他的想象力何等惊人——即便人们读他的书只为那些思想，也大有可咀嚼之处。

义项: 动词 修剪（树枝）（pruning to promote safety）
动词 (引申义) 精简；删减（prune a budget / a manuscript）
名词 西梅干、李子干——同形异义
搭配说明: pruning — n. 修剪——真题以此形出现
arborist — n. 树艺师、树木养护师——真题同现
prune ≠ prune back — 真题取「修枝养护」义

例句.英文: Arborists assess tree health and perform maintenance such as pruning to promote safety and prevent problems.
例句.中文: 树艺师负责评估树木健康状况，并施行修剪之类的养护，以提升安全性、防患于未然。

例句.英文: Japanese bonsai artist Masashi Hirao has crafted an approach that transforms the acts of pruning, wiring, and planting into dynamic public performances.
例句.中文: 日本盆景艺术家平尾成志打磨出一种手法，把修剪、蟠扎、栽种变成充满动感的公开表演。

义项: 名词 政策语境：为某群体或某商品设定的数量上限（quotas for underrepresented groups）
名词 贸易语境：进口配额，常与 tariff 并列

例句.英文: While some philosophers argue that certain types of underrepresentation (of women, for example) are unfair in principle and should be remediated via quotas, there is broad agreement that youth underrepresentation is not inherently unfair since it is universal (all people are underrepresented when young), temporary (underrepresented young people become overrepresented older people), and reflective of a legitimate concern (lack of relevant experience).
例句.中文: 尽管一些哲学家认为，某些类型的代表性不足（例如女性）在原则上不公平、应通过配额加以纠正，但人们普遍认为，青年群体的代表性不足本身并非不公，因为它是普遍的、暂时的，并且反映了一种合理的关切。

义项: 形容词 书面语，指平凡琐碎的日常生活，带文学与学术色彩
形容词 医学语境：quotidian fever 每日发作的热病
形容词 强调缺乏戏剧性，常与 sublime / extraordinary 对举

例句.英文: A category that resists firm delineation, folk art is generally defined by an intimate connection to quotidian life.
例句.中文: 民间艺术是一个难以严格界定的类别，通常被定义为与日常生活有着密切关联。

义项: 动词 使随机化；随机排列（randomized recordings / trials）
动词 randomized controlled trial 随机对照试验——实验设计核心术语
搭配说明: random / randomly — adj. 随机的 / adv. 随机地
randomization — n. 随机化
randomize ≠ randomize the order of — 真题作 randomized recordings 随机排序的录音

例句.英文: Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Singapore and Samoa, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh.
例句.中文: 来自21个社会（包括新加坡与萨摩亚）的研究参与者聆听了随机排序的录音：其中18段是取自女性二人自然对话的自发性笑声，另18段是18位不同女性按指令刻意发出的自主性笑声。

义项: 动词 纠正；矫正（rectify a mistake / an situation）
[构词] rect-（直，同 correct）+ -ify
搭配说明: rectification — n. 校正；整改
correct / rectitude — v. 改正 / n. 正直——同根
rectify ≠ ratify — 形近异义：后者是「批准、认可」

例句.英文: As they sat down they turned almost invariably to the person sitting next them, and rectified and continued what they had just said in public.
例句.原书高亮: rectified and continued what they had just said
例句.中文: 他们一落座，几乎无一例外地转向坐在自己旁边的人，把刚才当众说过的话再修正一番、接着说下去。

义项: 名词 冷藏；制冷（before refrigeration 在冷藏技术出现之前）
[构词] re- + frig（冷，同 frigid）+ -ation
搭配说明: refrigerate / refrigerator — v. 冷藏 / n. 冰箱
refrigerant — n. 制冷剂——真题另现
refrigeration ≠ refrigeration cycle — 后者是「制冷循环」

例句.英文: Before refrigeration, food was preserved using salt, smoking, or ice harvested from frozen lakes.
例句.中文: 在冷藏技术出现之前，人们用盐腌、烟熏，或从封冻的湖面取冰来保存食物。

例句.英文: They wanted to know whether torsional cooling could be used as a refrigeration method. .
例句.中文: 他们想知道扭转制冷能否用作一种制冷方法。

义项: 动词 再生；重新长出（regenerate tissue / limbs）
动词 (引申义) （使）复兴、恢复（regenerate a neighborhood）
搭配说明: regeneration — n. 再生；复兴
regenerative — adj. 再生的； regenerative medicine 再生医学
regenerate ≠ regenerate into — 真题取「（人体）有限的再生能力」义

例句.英文: Researchers are investigating this feat partly to learn more about humans’ comparatively limited abilities to regenerate, and they’re making exciting progress.
例句.中文: 研究者探究这一本领，部分是为了进一步了解人类相对有限的再生能力；目前他们正取得令人振奋的进展。

例句.英文: Most animals can regenerate some parts of their bodies, such as skin.
例句.中文: 多数动物能再生身体的某些部分，例如皮肤。

义项: 名词 重复；反复重申（reiteration of the same structures）
[构词] re-（再）+ iteration（一次重复）
搭配说明: reiterate / iterate — v. 重申 / v. 迭代
reiteration ≠ repetition — 前者偏「有意识地一再申说」，后者中性
perpetually revisit — 真题近义表达：不断重返同一母题

例句.英文: Paintings by the Florida Highwaymen—an informal collective of prolific landscape artists active in Florida during the 1950s and '60s—are recognizable by their reiteration of the same general compositional structures and subjects: moonlit waters and grassy inland rivers, to name two.
例句.原书高亮: their reiteration of the same general compositional structures
例句.中文: 佛罗里达公路画家（一个活跃于20世纪五六十年代、松散联合的多产风景画家群体）的画作，因反复采用同一套总体构图与母题而一眼可辨：月光下的水面、草木繁茂的内陆河流，仅举两例。

义项: 动词 排斥；相斥（matter and antimatter repel rather than attract）
动词 (引申义) 击退（敌人）；使反感；防水（water-repellent）
搭配说明: repellent / repulsion — adj./n. 驱避剂 / n. 排斥
repel ≠ compel / expel — 同根 pel-（推）三词常混考
attract — v. 吸引——反义，真题同句对举

例句.英文: In their 2022 paper, Christos Dimopoulos et al., having granted that the existence of antigravity—in which antimatter and matter repel rather than attract each other—lacked affirmative experimental support, rightly argued that such antigravity was worth considering on theoretical grounds given that evidence against it was similarly lacking.
例句.原书高亮: antimatter and matter repel rather than attract each other
例句.中文: 在2022年的论文中，Christos Dimopoulos 等人先承认「反重力」（即反物质与物质相互排斥而非吸引）缺乏肯定性的实验支持，随后又合理地主张：鉴于反对它的证据同样缺乏，这种反重力在理论层面仍值得考虑。

例句.英文: One end of a soap molecule is hydrophobic (water repelling), and one end is hydrophilic (water attracting)..
例句.中文: 肥皂分子的一端是疏水的（排斥水），另一端是亲水的（吸引水）。

义项: 形容词 灿烂的；绚丽夺目的（resplendent in / with）
[构词] re-（加强）+ splend（光辉，同 splendid）+ -ent
搭配说明: splendid / splendor — adj. 壮丽的 / n. 光辉
resplendent ≠ resplendently — 后者是副词
radiant / lustrous — adj. 光彩照人的 / adj. 有光泽的——近义

例句.英文: The pine cones were pungent, the pine green was resplendent.
例句.中文: 松果气味浓烈，松绿一色明艳照人。

义项: 名词 研究如何有效说服的技艺与理论（theories of rhetoric）
名词 含贬义时指华而不实或别有用心的话（empty rhetoric）

例句.英文: Conventional theories of rhetoric hold that presenting information as coming from credentialed experts increases that information's credibility.
例句.原书高亮: theories of rhetoric hold that presenting
例句.中文: 传统修辞学理论认为，把信息呈现为来自有资质的专家，会提高该信息的可信度。

义项: 动词 嘲笑；奚落（ridicule an idea）
名词 嘲弄；笑柄（an object of ridicule）
搭配说明: ridiculous — adj. 荒唐可笑的——真题亦现
ridicule ≠ ridiculously — 后者是副词
mock / deride — v. 嘲弄 / v. 讥讽——近义

例句.英文: George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris's having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he—George himself—who had done all the labour worth speaking of.
例句.中文: 乔治则反过来嘲笑「哈里斯除了吃和睡还干过别的」这个说法，并且铁板钉钉地认定：所有值得一提的活儿都是他——乔治本人——干的。

例句.英文: Philosophy is often ridiculed as an area of study that offers no real benefit in students’ job-hunting effort.
例句.中文: 哲学常被讥讽为一门对学生求职毫无实际助益的学问。

义项: 动词 使饱和；浸透（be saturated with）
动词 （颜色）饱和度高的：a very saturated blue-green
搭配说明: saturation / saturated — n. 饱和（度） / adj. 饱和的
saturate ≠ saturate with — 真题取「色彩极浓」义
saturated ≠ unsaturated fat — 不饱和脂肪——同形异义

例句.英文: Olo is a very saturated blue-green color that can’t be seen with the human eye under natural conditions.
例句.中文: Olo 是一种饱和度极高的蓝绿色，人眼在自然条件下是看不到的。

例句.英文: Analyses of Rembrandt's seventeenth-century painting The Night Watch, citing its richly saturated colors and stark contrasts between light and shadow, often characterize the work as an exemplar of the Baroque-era style.
例句.中文: 对伦勃朗 17 世纪画作《夜巡》的分析，常援引其浓饱和的色彩与光暗之间的强烈反差，将其奉为巴洛克风格的典范。

义项: 动词 闲逛；漫步（saunter along / through）
名词 闲步、溜达
搭配说明: sauntered — v. 过去式——真题以此形出现
saunter ≠ sauntering — 后者是现在分词 / 形容词
stroll / amble — v. 漫步——近义

例句.英文: I sauntered along, forgetful of musty papers, of the offices, of my chief …
例句.原书高亮: I sauntered along, forgetful of musty papers
例句.中文: 我一路闲逛，把那些发霉的纸堆、办公室、我的上司、同事、文件全抛在脑后，只想着那些必定会降临于我的好事，想着未来所包含的一切隐而未露的未知。

义项: 动词 皱眉；怒视（scowl at sb）
名词 愁容、不悦的脸色
搭配说明: scowling — n./adj. 皱眉（的）——真题以此形出现
scowl ≠ scowl at — 真题作 in his scowling 在他皱眉的样子里
frown / glower — v. 皱眉 / v. 怒视——近义

例句.英文: There was a hidden dignity in his scowling as he shuffled about pondering the least ridiculous place for the picture.
例句.原书高亮: There was a hidden dignity in his scowling
例句.中文: 他一边踱着步、盘算着把这幅画挂在何处才最不显得荒唐，一边皱着眉；那皱眉的样子里藏着一种不为人察的尊严。

义项: 名词 抄写员；文书（Indigenous scribes 原住民抄写者）
名词 (引申义) （古犹太教的）经师、律法学者
搭配说明: scribe ≠ scribble — 后者是「潦草涂写」
scribe ≠ describe / prescribe / subscribe — 同根 scrib-（写）常混考
manuscript — n. 手稿——真题同现

例句.英文: Compiled in the late 1500s largely through the efforts of Indigenous scribes, Cantares Mexicanos is the most important collection of poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the principal language of the Aztec Empire.
例句.原书高亮: largely through the efforts of Indigenous scribes
例句.中文: 《墨西哥歌谣集》（Cantares Mexicanos）主要靠原住民抄写者的努力于十六世纪末汇编而成，是古典纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克帝国的主要语言）最重要的诗歌总集。

义项: 动词 仔细审视；细察（scrutinize data / arrangements）
[构词] scrut-（搜查，同 scrutiny）+ -ize
搭配说明: scrutiny — n. 细察；详细审查
scrutinized — v. 过去分词——真题以此形出现
scrutinize ≠ scan — 后者只是「扫一眼 / 浏览」

例句.英文: The most extensive investigations have scrutinized only 106–107 crystalline arrangements, a large absolute number but only a small subset of theoretically possible stable chemical combinations.
例句.中文: 迄今最广泛的研究也只细察了10⁶–10⁷种晶体排列——绝对数量不小，却只是理论上可能存在的稳定化学组合中的一小部分。

义项: 形容词 开创性的；影响深远的（a seminal study / work）
[辨析] seminal（学术上的「奠基性」）≠ seminar（研讨课）≠ semantic（语义的）
搭配说明: seminal ≠ seminally — 后者是副词
seminal 1979 study — 真题搭配：1979年的奠基性研究（Kahneman & Tversky）
groundbreaking / foundational — adj. 开创性的——近义

例句.英文: In a seminal 1979 study, Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky presented students and college faculty from Israel, Sweden, and the United States with hypothetical questions involving financial decisions.
例句.中文: 文本1：在1979年一项奠基性研究中，Daniel Kahneman 与 Amos Tversky 向来自以色列、瑞典和美国的学生与大学教师提出了一系列涉及财务决策的假设性问题。

例句.英文: Allen won the award in 2006 for seminal contributions to optimizing compiler techniques.

义项: 名词 （碳的）封存；固存（soil carbon sequestration）
名词 (引申义) 隔离；扣押（法律义）
搭配说明: sequester / sequestered — v. 封存；隔离 / adj. 与世隔绝的
carbon sequestration — 碳封存——真题气候类固定术语
sequestration ≠ sequestration of — 真题作 contribute meaningfully to soil carbon sequestration

例句.英文: Based on data from numerous farm fields, Poeplau and his coauthor concluded that cover crops contribute meaningfully to soil carbon sequestration and, if widely adopted, could help offset agricultural emissions of atmospheric CO₂ and other greenhouse gases.
例句.中文: 基于大量农田的数据，Poeplau 及其合著者得出结论：覆盖作物对土壤碳封存有实质贡献；若被广泛采用，可帮助抵消农业排放的大气 CO₂ 及其他温室气体。

例句.英文: While these crops are known for increasing biodiversity, Christopher Poeplau and his coauthor argued in a 2015 study that cover crops’ role in supporting soil carbon sequestration deserves more attention.
例句.中文: 尽管这些作物以增加生物多样性著称，Christopher Poeplau 与其合作者在 2015 年的研究中主张：覆盖作物在支持土壤碳固存方面的作用值得更多关注。

义项: 名词 薄而窄的一小条、一小片（a sliver of light / a sliver of open eyes）
[辨析] 与 slice（切下的一片）相比更细、更不规则；真题 Beneath our lashes, in the sliver of open eyes 写 eyelid 微睁的一线视野

例句.英文: Beneath our lashes, in the sliver of open eyes, stars twinkle in the colors of the winter rainbow.
例句.原书高亮: in the sliver of open eyes,
例句.中文: 在我们的睫毛之下、在眼睛睁开的那道细缝里，星星闪着冬日虹彩的颜色。

义项: 动词 使透不过气；闷住；紧紧裹住（be smothered in an embrace）
动词 (引申义) 压灭（火）；抑制（情感、声音）；溺爱（smother with love）
搭配说明: smothered — adj. 被闷住的——真题以此形出现
smother ≠ smother in — 真题作 half smothered in the clasp of two arms
suffocate / stifle — v. 使窒息 / v. 抑制——近义

例句.英文: The next moment she found herself half smothered in the clasp of two gingham-clad arms.“Oh, I’m so glad, GLAD, GLAD to see you,” cried an eager voice in her ear.
例句.原书高亮: half smothered in the clasp of two gingham-clad arms
例句.中文: 下一刻，她就发现自己被两条穿格子布衫的胳膊搂得几乎透不过气。「噢，见到你我真高兴、真高兴、真高兴，」一个热切的声音在她耳边嚷道。

义项: 动词 求得；请求；招徕（solicit affection / attention / feedback）
[辨析] solicit（主动去讨要）≠ solicitous（adj. 关切的、挂念的）
搭配说明: solicitation / solicitor — n. 恳求；招揽 / n. 律师（英式）
solicit ≠ elicit — 形近异义：后者是「引出（回答、反应）」
solicit ≠ solicit attention — 真题作 a dog solicits affection or attention

例句.英文: This was the case for both separation problems and dog rivalry but was especially pronounced for attachment and attention-seeking, which can be seen when a dog solicits affection or attention.
例句.原书高亮: when a dog solicits affection or attention
例句.中文: 分离难题与犬只争宠两类情形都是如此，但在依恋与寻求关注上尤为突出——比如狗主动讨要爱抚或注意时就能看到。

义项: 形容词 稀疏的；稀少的（sparse data / vegetation / population）
[辨析] sparse（数量少、分布稀）≠ scarce（短缺、不够用）
搭配说明: sparsely / sparsity — adv. 稀疏地 / n. 稀疏（度）
sparse ≠ sparse and discrepant — 真题两词并列：既稀疏又彼此矛盾
dense — adj. 密集的——反义

例句.英文: For Titan, Saturn's largest moon, the observational data that exist are too sparse and discrepant to fully constrain the range of the methane mole fraction at various atmospheric levels.
例句.原书高亮: too sparse and discrepant to fully constrain
例句.中文: 就土星最大的卫星土卫六而言，现有的观测数据过于稀疏且彼此矛盾，无法充分限定各处大气层高度上甲烷摩尔分数的范围。

例句.英文: Portolan charts in the Venetian tradition tended to be sparse in illustrations..
例句.中文: 威尼斯传统的波托兰海图插图通常较为稀疏。

义项: 动词 带头；率先发起（spearhead an initiative / a campaign）
名词 矛头；先锋、领头者
搭配说明: spearhead ≠ spearhead local civil rights initiatives — 真题取动词义
spearheaded — v. 过去分词
lead / pioneer — v. 领导 / v. 开创——近义

例句.英文: Led by experienced organizers such as Dorothy Cotton and Septima Clark, CEP attendees—more than 7,000 in all—participated in workshops on topics ranging from public speaking to legal doctrine before returning home and using their newly acquired knowledge to spearhead local civil rights initiatives.
例句.原书高亮: to spearhead local civil rights initiatives
例句.中文: 在 Dorothy Cotton、Septima Clark 等经验丰富的组织者带领下，CEP 的参加者（总计七千余人）参加了从公开演说到法律教义等各类工作坊，随后回到家乡，用新学到的知识带头推动当地的民权行动。

例句.英文: He spearheaded economic initiatives promoting African agricultural infrastructure.
例句.中文: 他牵头推动了促进非洲农业基础设施的经济倡议。

义项: 形容词 细长而弱的；瘦长得摇摇欲坠的（spindly columns / legs）
[构词] spindle（纺锤）+ -y
搭配说明: spindle — n. 纺锤；主轴
spindly ≠ spindly but still miraculously upright — 真题取「细长却仍直立」的反差
gangly / lanky — adj. 瘦长笨拙的——近义

例句.英文: But it was still amazing.Behind the lamassu, more columns sprouted from the ground like ancient trees in a petrified forest, forty feet tall, spindly but still miraculously upright.
例句.中文: 可它依然令人惊叹。在那尊人首牛身像之后，更多柱子从地面拔起，像一片石化森林里的古树，高达四十英尺，细长得摇摇欲坠，却仍奇迹般地直立着。

义项: 动词 蔓延；杂乱地伸展开（sprawl across / out）
名词 （城市）无序扩张：urban sprawl
形容词 sprawling adj. 铺陈浩大、枝蔓横生的（a sprawling work）
搭配说明: sprawling — adj. 庞大而枝蔓横生的——真题以此形出现
sprawl ≠ sprawl out — 真题取「篇幅浩大、跨数十年连载」义
sprawl ≠ sprawled — 后者是动词过去式

例句.英文: The 2020 poetry collection Echoing Quartet continues Adrian Bell’s “long song,” a sprawling work that consists of a pair of serialized poems called Song of the Andoumboulou and Mu, whose joint publication spans multiple installments over several decades.
例句.原书高亮: a sprawling work that consists of a pair of serialized poems
例句.中文: 2020年的诗集《回响四重奏》延续了 Adrian Bell 的「长歌」——一部枝蔓横生的作品，由《Andoumboulou 之歌》与《Mu》两首连载长诗构成，两者合刊的发表过程跨越数十年、分多期面世。

义项: 名词 （尤指东南欧 / 中亚的）草原、干草原：the Pontic-Caspian Steppe 黑海—里海草原
[辨析] steppe（无树干的温带草原）≠ prairie（北美高草草原）≠ savanna（热带稀树草原）
搭配说明: steppe ≠ step — 后者是「台阶、步骤」
steppe ≠ steppes — 真题以专名大写单数出现
Pontic-Caspian Steppe — 真题历史语言学固定地名

例句.英文: As part of their findings, the team also presented a hypothesis as to how Indo-European spread, proposing that a major branch of Indo-European traveled northward from the language family’s source to the Pontic-Caspian Steppe, expanding from there across much of Europe.
例句.中文: 作为研究发现的一部分，该团队还就印欧语系如何扩散提出假说：印欧语系的一个主要分支从该语系的发源地北上，抵达黑海—里海草原，再由那里向欧洲大部扩张。

例句.英文: Many linguists support the steppe hypothesis, which holds that the Indo-European language family originated approximately 6,000 years before present (YBP) on the Pontic-Caspian Steppe.
例句.中文: 许多语言学家支持草原假说：印欧语系约于 6000 年前发源于庞廷-里海草原。

义项: 名词 在平板、刻写板上书写 / 绘画的尖笔；古代亦指蜡板书写用的尖头工具
名词 (引申义) （唱机）唱针；真题以「Painting」with a tablet and stylus 与 paint and a brush 对举，考「技术替代手艺」

例句.英文: Painting” with a tablet and stylus is much easier than using paint and a brush: the technology is doing most of the work.
例句.原书高亮: tablet and stylus is much easier
例句.中文: 用平板加触控笔「作画」，比用颜料和画笔容易得多：大部分工作都由技术替你做了。

例句.英文: It first appeared in Stylus in 1921.
例句.中文: 它最初发表于 1921 年的 Stylus 杂志。

义项: 名词 主观性（与 objectivity 客观性 相对）
[辨析] subjectivity ≠ subjection（征服、屈从）≠ subject matter（题材）
搭配说明: subjective / objectively — adj. 主观的 / adv. 客观地
subjectivity ≠ subjectivity of — 真题作 imbued with disagreement and subjectivity
objectivity — n. 客观性——反义

例句.英文: … Susan Silbey has observed that “the meaning of the word ‘culture’…is unstable.” This conceptual instability contributes to a discrepancy between reality (which is complex but ultimately consistent) and our understanding of reality (a matter of attempted consensus, imbued with disagreement and subjectivity).
例句.中文: 的确，Susan Silbey 说过，文化一词的含义是不稳定的。这种概念上的不稳定，造成了现实（虽复杂却终究自洽）与我们对现实的理解（一种试图达成共识、却浸透着分歧与主观性的东西）之间的落差。

义项: 名词 政府为扶持某行业或降低某价格而支付的款项（government subsidies, farm subsidies）
名词 对特定群体或个人发放的补助（housing subsidy）

例句.英文: Robeyns cites the work of economist Mariana Mazzucato, who shows that government subsidies are a more effective engine of innovation than private sector investments; in addition, government-funded innovations tend to lead to further developments in disparate fields (such as the United States mission to land a person on the Moon, which accelerated developments in textiles as well as electronics).
例句.原书高亮: that government subsidies are a more
例句.中文: 罗宾斯援引经济学家玛丽安娜·马祖卡托的研究指出，政府补贴是比私营部门投资更有效的创新引擎；此外，政府资助的创新往往会带动其他领域的进一步发展。

义项: 动词 维持生计；勉强糊口（subsist on / chiefly on）
动词 (引申义) （靠…）存在、存续
搭配说明: subsistence — n. 生计； subsistence farming 自给农业
subsist ≠ subsist on — 真题作 subsisted chiefly on the framing of pictures 主要靠装画框维持
subsist ≠ consist / resist / insist — 同根 sist-（站立）常混考

例句.英文: It was only a little out-of-the-way store which subsisted chiefly on the framing of pictures.
例句.原书高亮: which subsisted chiefly on the framing of pictures
例句.中文: 那不过是一家偏僻的小店，主要靠替人装画框勉强维持。

义项: 动词 以实证材料证明某一主张成立（substantiate an allegation）
动词 把抽象说法落实为可核查的细节或数据
动词 哲学：赋予某物以实体存在

例句.英文: For example, the firefly squid scores 1 because of inconsistent reports, the emperor squid scores 4 because of its anatomical similarity to known luminous relatives, and the shaggy anglerfish scores 6 because of substantiated direct observations.
例句.中文: 例如，萤火虫鱿鱼因报告不一致而得 1 分，大王乌贼因与已知发光近缘种的解剖学相似性而得 4 分，而长须鮟鱇因有确凿的直接观察证据而得 6 分。

义项: 形容词 用最少的话把意思说清，含褒义（succinct and clear）
形容词 结构紧凑、不铺陈；与 terse 的冷淡意味不同
形容词 古义：紧束的、收拢的

例句.英文: Political scientists have asserted that by providing succinct and clear information about candidates and issues, campaign advertisements should reduce the differences in political knowledge observed between groups of voters.
例句.原书高亮: by providing succinct and clear information
例句.中文: 政治学者认为，竞选广告通过提供简洁清晰的信息介绍候选人与议题，应当能够缩小不同选民群体之间在政治知识上的差距。

义项: 形容词 超出所需而显得不必要（superfluous detail）
形容词 数量上供大于求；与 surplus 近义，但更强调无必要
形容词 文本或论证中可删去而不损意义的部分

例句.英文: The appearance of hide-scraping tools by 780,000 years ago (780 Ka) enabled clothing production but does not entail it, and while clothing is thought to have been thermally superfluous for anatomically modern humans in their African range around their emergence by 300 Ka, it was essential for the persistence of humans outside Africa by 70 Ka.
例句.原书高亮: been thermally superfluous for anatomically modern
例句.中文: 距今 78 万年前刮皮工具的出现使衣物生产成为可能，但并不意味着必然发生；虽然对生活在非洲、约 30 万年前出现的解剖学意义上的现代人而言，衣物在保暖上被认为是多余的，但对 7 万年前走出非洲的人类的存续却不可或缺。

义项: 名词 切分（节奏）；切分音——重拍偏离稳定拍子的节奏复杂形式
名词 （词的）中音省略：syncope
搭配说明: syncopated — adj. 切分节奏的
syncopation ≠ syncopation of — 真题作 rhythmic complexity known as syncopation
groove rating — 律动感评分——真题同现

例句.英文: Keller and Schubert;: Syncopation " produces expectancy violationsby emphasizing weak temporal locations and de-emphasizing strong locations." .
例句.中文: 这一假说基于对一种被称为切分的特定节奏复杂形式的研究发现——切分指演奏的拍子偏离了歌曲稳定而潜在的脉动——研究表明适度的切分与最高的律动感评分相关联。

例句.英文: This hypothesis was hased on findings about a specific torm of rhythmic complexity knownas syncopationtwhen beats played in the rhythm deviate from the steady, underlying pulse of asong), which suggested that moderate syncopation was a50Cisted with the highest groove ratings.
例句.中文: 该假说基于对一种特定节奏复杂性——切分（节拍偏离歌曲稳定的底层律动）——的研究：适度的切分与最高的「律动感」评分相关。

义项: 形容词 论证、关联缺乏实质支撑（a tenuous connection, a tenuous argument）
形容词 物理义：细长而易断（a tenuous thread）
形容词 气体或氛围（tenuous atmosphere）

例句.英文: For example, the common difrasismo in cuauhtli in ocelotl (literally, “the eagle, the jaguar”) signifies “warrior.” The device's function is both formal—providing structure to lines of verse—and ritual: semantic relations among the two nouns and the concept they signify can be tenuous, as in the previous example, such that difrasismos are often only intelligible according to the conceptual associations observed in Aztec ceremonial culture.
例句.中文: 例如，cuauhtli in ocelotl（字面意为鹰、美洲豹）这一常见的 difrasismo 表示武士。该修辞手法的功能既是形式上的——为诗句提供结构——也是仪式性的：两个名词与其所指概念之间的语义关联可能十分薄弱，如上例所示，以至于这类 difrasismo 往往只有依据阿兹特克仪式文化中的概念联想才能理解。

义项: 形容词 主题的；题旨的（thematic aims / concerns / coherence）
[构词] theme + -atic
搭配说明: theme / thematically — n. 主题 / adv. 就主题而言
thematic ≠ thematic aims — 真题作 central to Asimov's thematic aims
thematic ≠ thematic apperception test — 主题统觉测验——心理学专名

例句.英文: Thus his lack of characterization is central to Asimov's thematic aims.
例句.中文: 因此，他缺乏人物刻画这一点，恰恰是阿西莫夫题旨追求的核心。

义项: 名词 拓扑；拓扑结构（leaf-vein topologies 叶脉拓扑）
[构词] topo-（地方、形态）+ -logy
搭配说明: topological — adj. 拓扑的
reticulate (netlike) — adj. 网状的——真题同现
topology ≠ topography — 后者是「地形学」——形近异义，SAT 易考

例句.英文: … reticulate (netlike) leaf-vein topologies in plants are thought to reduce efficiency in water and sugar transport and to increase vein construction costs relative to branched topologies.
例句.中文: 植物的网状（网格状）叶脉拓扑虽有利于在叶脉被堵塞时预先防止维管功能丧失，但人们认为它会降低水分与糖分运输的效率，并相对于分支状拓扑提高叶脉的构建成本。

义项: 形容词 因过度使用而失去新意的说法或观念（a trite remark）
形容词 强调缺乏原创性，比 commonplace 更带批评
形容词 文学评论中形容意象、比喻陈旧落套

例句.英文: Still, to a close observer, they are just as perceptible; the difference is that their media of manifestation are less trite and familiar than such well-known ones as the bursting of the buds or the fall of the leaf.
例句.原书高亮: are less trite and familiar than
例句.中文: 不过，在细心的观察者看来，它们同样可感；差别只在于，它们的显现媒介不如萌芽、落叶这些众所周知的现象那样陈腐而熟悉。

义项: 形容词 青翠的；草木葱茏的（verdant sheen / hills / landscape）
[构词] verd-（绿，同 verdure）+ -ant
搭配说明: verdure — n. 青翠；草木
verdant ≠ verdant sheen of silver — 真题文学描写：银中带翠的润泽
lush / luxuriant — adj. 茂盛的——近义

例句.英文: … had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver …
例句.中文: 高大的水栎上的苔藓被一层银中带翠的润泽点亮，像狂欢节的彩饰，又像为悼亡而悬挂的丧礼装饰，垂挂下来。

义项: 名词 遗迹；残余（vestiges of a performance context）
名词 退化器官：vestigial organ
搭配说明: vestigial — adj. 残留的；退化的
vestige ≠ vestige of — 真题常用复数 vestiges
trace / remnant — n. 痕迹 / n. 残余——近义

例句.英文: … the vernacular riddles of early medieval England contain “implicit vestiges” of an interactive performance context …
例句.中文: 学者 Jill Frederick 认为，现代读者多半把中世纪早期英格兰的方言谜语当作死的书面文本来接触，其中却含有一种互动表演语境的隐性遗迹。

义项: 名词 高架桥；谷架桥（跨越河谷、道路的多孔桥）
[构词] via（路）+ duct（引导，同 aqueduct 渡槽）
搭配说明: viaduct ≠ aqueduct — 后者是「渡槽、引水渠」
viaduct ≠ viaduct of — 真题作 the great viaduct of Point du Jour
aqueduct / duct — n. 渡槽 / n. 管道——同根

例句.英文: And suddenly I perceived the great viaduct of Point du Jour which blocked the river.
例句.原书高亮: the great viaduct of Point du Jour
例句.中文: 蓦然间，我望见了横阻在河上的那座巨大的 Point du Jour 高架桥。

义项: 名词 研究语境：呈现给被试的简短情境描述（presented participants with vignettes）
名词 文学体裁：寥寥数笔勾勒人物或场景的短篇
名词 摄影 / 设计：画面边缘逐渐淡出的效果

例句.英文: The florilegium includes a vignette painting by contributing artist Sibonelo Chiliza.
例句.中文: 亚历山德罗·奈等人向研究参与者呈现了关于虚构政治候选人的短文，把这些候选人刻画为体现某种被普遍视为可贵的性格特质（如宜人性），或某种被视为卑劣的特质（如犬儒）。

义项: 动词 把…称为；给…起绰号（be dubbed + 名称）——真题几乎全为此义
动词 为（影片）配音；译制
动词 （dub）混音、Dubstep 一类的电子乐风格
搭配说明: dub ≠ dub in — 真题取「命名为」，不是「配音」
dubbed a mixtap/e/ssay — 真题原句：被称作「混带／随笔」的专辑
nickname / christen — v. 起绰号 / v. 命名——近义

例句.英文: A pair of European panda teeth found in Bulgaria led researchers to conclude that they likely belonged to an undiscovered species of panda that the researchers dubbed Agriarctos nikolovi.
例句.原书高亮: that the researchers dubbed Agriarctos nikolovi
例句.中文: 在保加利亚发现的一对欧洲熊猫牙齿使研究者得出结论：它们很可能属于一个此前未被发现的熊猫物种，研究者将其命名为 Agriarctos nikolovi。
